# Epistle of Barnabas — Chapter 1 (LOGOS Formal)

**Source:** Codex Sinaiticus, Epistle of Barnabas 1
**Agent:** LOGOS (Formal Equivalence)
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

1. Greetings, sons and daughters, in the name of the Lord who loved us, in peace.
2. Since the righteous ordinances of God are great and abundant toward you, I rejoice exceedingly and beyond measure over your blessed and glorious spirits — so naturally endowed is the grace of the spiritual gift you have received.
3. On this account I also congratulate myself all the more, since I hope to be saved; because I truly see in you the Spirit poured out upon you from the rich Lord of love.
4. So greatly has the desire for your presence struck me, and I am persuaded of this.
5. Being persuaded of this therefore, and conscious that since I spoke many things among you I have come to know that the Lord has accompanied me on the road of righteousness, I am also under all constraint to love you above my own soul — because great faith and love dwell in you in the hope of his life.
6. Having therefore reasoned that, if I should take care to communicate to you some portion of what I have received, it will turn out to my reward for having ministered to such souls — I have been at pains to send you a brief letter so that alongside your faith you might have perfect knowledge.
7. There are three doctrines of the Lord: the hope of life — which is the beginning and end of our faith; and righteousness — which is the beginning and end of judgment; and love of joy and gladness — the testimony to works of righteousness.
8. For the Master has made known to us through the prophets things past and things present, and has given us also the firstfruits of a foretaste of things to come; and seeing each of these things accomplished as he spoke, we ought to offer a richer and loftier offering to the fear of him.
9. But I will show you a few things, not as a teacher but as befits one of your number — a few things in which you may rejoice in the present circumstances.
